description_en: Queries the list of AI model cards
name: ListAiModelCards

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance. The target instance must exist, belong to the current account, and be of the AI gateway type
parameters.help_zh: AI 网关实例 ID。目标实例必须存在、属于当前账号且类型为 AI 网关
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match keyword for the model provider identifier or model name. If left empty, all model cards under the current gateway are queried
parameters.help_zh: 模型供应商标识或模型名称的模糊匹配关键字。留空时查询当前网关下全部模型卡片
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码。默认值为 1，取值大于或等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量。默认值为 10，取值范围为 1～500
parameters.name: page_size

code.description_en: The response status code. Ok is returned when the request is successful
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。请求成功时返回 Ok

availablePaths.description_en: The list of invocation paths supported by the model. Each item contains both path and type
availablePaths.description_zh: 模型支持的调用路径列表。每一项同时包含 path 和 type

items.description_en: A single model invocation path configuration
items.description_zh: 单个模型调用路径配置

path.description_en: The model invocation path. The maximum length is 2048 characters
path.description_zh: 模型调用路径，长度不超过 2048 个字符

type.description_en: The protocol type corresponding to the path. The maximum length is 64 characters
type.description_zh: 路径对应的协议类型，长度不超过 64 个字符

credit.description_en: The credit billing information of the model. The unit is Credits per million tokens
credit.description_zh: 模型的 Credit 计费信息。费用单位为 Credits/百万 Token

cacheCost.description_en: The cost of cache-hit tokens, in Credits per million tokens
cacheCost.description_zh: 缓存命中 Token 费用，单位为 Credits/百万 Token

inputCost.description_en: The cost of input tokens, in Credits per million tokens
inputCost.description_zh: 输入 Token 费用，单位为 Credits/百万 Token

outputCost.description_en: The cost of output tokens, in Credits per million tokens
outputCost.description_zh: 输出 Token 费用，单位为 Credits/百万 Token

type.description_en: The billing type. Currently, only fixed is supported
type.description_zh: 计费类型。当前仅支持 fixed

features.description_en: The model capability switches. Keys are model capability names supported by the API gateway, and values are Boolean values
features.description_zh: 模型能力开关。键为 API 网关支持的模型能力名称，值为布尔值

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the model card belongs
gatewayId.description_zh: 模型卡片所属的 AI 网关实例 ID

meta.description_en: The token limits and input/output modality information of the model
meta.description_zh: 模型的 Token 上限和输入、输出模态信息

maxInputTokens.description_en: The maximum number of input tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
maxInputTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的最大输入 Token 数。取值大于或等于 0

maxOutputTokens.description_en: The maximum number of output tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
maxOutputTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的最大输出 Token 数。取值大于或等于 0

maxTokens.description_en: The maximum total number of context tokens supported by the model. The value must be greater than or equal to 0
maxTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的上下文最大 Token 总数。取值大于或等于 0

supportedInputModalities.description_en: The list of input modalities supported by the model. The list contains up to 16 items, and each item must not be empty
supportedInputModalities.description_zh: 模型支持的输入模态列表，最多包含 16 项，每一项均不能为空

items.description_en: A single modality name in the input modality list
items.description_zh: 输入模态列表中的单个模态名称

supportedOutputModalities.description_en: The list of output modalities supported by the model. The list contains up to 16 items, and each item must not be empty
supportedOutputModalities.description_zh: 模型支持的输出模态列表，最多包含 16 项，每一项均不能为空

items.description_en: A single modality name in the output modality list
items.description_zh: 输出模态列表中的单个模态名称

modelCardId.description_en: The model card ID. The ID is generated by the system and starts with mc-
modelCardId.description_zh: 模型卡片 ID。由系统生成，格式以 mc- 开头

source.description_en: The source of the model card. For instance-level model cards, user is returned
source.description_zh: 模型卡片来源。当前实例级模型卡片返回 user

sourceURL.description_en: The URL of the model metadata

updateTime.description_en: The last update time of the model card, in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
updateTime.description_zh: 模型卡片的最近更新时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for the current page

totalSize.description_en: The total number of model cards that match the query conditions
totalSize.description_zh: 符合条件的模型卡片总数

message.description_en: The response message. success is returned when the request is successful
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求成功时返回 success

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is generated by the system and used to locate this call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，由系统生成，用于定位本次调用
